paragraphs: Ketia bar Shalom. A righteous convert; he was a minister at the emperor's court. He was assured of life in the World to Come, circumcised himself, and gave his wealth to R' Akiva and his colleagues (see there). He rectified Avimelekh, king of Gerar (Gilgulei Neshamot, Kof 1).
